body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on 'CES 2008') -- <Visual News & Press Release> iRobot announced the iRobot Dirt Dog Shop Sweeping Robot during CES 2008.
iRobot Dirt Dog Shop Sweeping Robot is a tenacious cleaner that picks up what you throw down.

Command iRobot Dirt Dog to clean and it gets to work sweeping under workbenches, cars and other hard-to-reach places. It picks up the small nuts, bolts, dirt, dust and other debris that end up on your shop floor. iRobot Dirt Dog features and oversized dust bin and high-speed, counter-rotating brushes to keep your workspace clean. Use on hard floors, shop carpets or industrial floor surfaces only.
